quarter.zh: 2027 财年第一季（9 月季度）

en: Revenue rose 19% to $92.3B against $90.7B expected, and EPS excluding OpenAI of $4.89 beat $4.73. Azure, reported in dollars for the first time, grew 48% to $33.2B, above the 44–45% guide. CFO Amy Hood guided December-quarter revenue to $96.0–97.1B, above the $95.6B consensus, and Azure to 49–50%, saying demand still exceeds supply. Capex of $45.2B fell short as third-party capacity slipped; she expects over $50B next quarter and faster spending later. Operating margin widened to 49.8%, and CEO Satya Nadella said Copilot daily users rose about 50%.

Shares closed at $531.01 before the report and rose about 4% after hours to roughly $552, trading between 2% and 5% higher. Faster Azure growth and a strong guide eased the AI-spending worries that Meta and Alphabet had revived, and positive free cash flow of $18.6B helped. A backlog flat at $677B and a capex shortfall that is partly timing tempered the gains. The first full session, on Oct 29, is still to come.
zh: 营收增长 19% 至 923 亿美元，高于 907 亿美元预期；不含 OpenAI 的每股收益 4.89 美元高于 4.73 美元。Azure 首次以美元金额披露，增长 48% 至 332 亿美元，高于 44–45% 的指引。CFO 艾米·胡德指引 12 月季度营收 960–971 亿美元，高于 956 亿的一致预期，Azure 增长 49–50%，并称需求仍超供给。因第三方产能交付推迟，资本开支 452 亿美元低于计划；她预计下季超过 500 亿，之后支出加快。营业利润率升至 49.8%，CEO 萨提亚·纳德拉称 Copilot 日活用户增长约 50%。
财报前股价收于 531.01 美元，盘后上涨约 4% 至约 552 美元，涨幅在 2% 至 5% 之间波动。Azure 提速和强劲指引缓解了 Meta 与 Alphabet 重新引发的 AI 支出担忧，186 亿美元的正自由现金流也起到支撑。积压订单持平于 6,770 亿美元，以及部分属于时间差的资本开支不足，限制了涨幅。10 月 29 日首个完整交易日的表现尚待观察。

bio.en: Joined Microsoft in 1992 and ran its server and cloud business before becoming CEO in 2014 and chairman in 2021. Led the shift to Azure and the OpenAI partnership.
bio.zh: 1992 年加入微软，曾负责服务器与云业务，2014 年出任 CEO，2021 年兼任董事长。主导了向 Azure 的转型以及与 OpenAI 的合作。

bio.en: CFO since 2013, the first woman in the role. Joined Microsoft in 2002 from Goldman Sachs and was CFO of the Business division; known for conservative, steady guidance.
bio.zh: 2013 年起任 CFO，是微软首位女性 CFO。2002 年从高盛加入微软，曾任商业事业部 CFO；以稳健保守的指引著称。

sources.t: Q1 FY27 results, guidance and after-hours move (CNBC)
